Intelligent Assist for VMware Cloud Foundation — a GenAI operations assistant for VCF administrators, built by Broadcom on VMware Private AI Services (Model Gallery + Agent Builder + retrieval) as a reference implementation of its own agentic AI stack. [VMware by Broadcom (Private AI Services)]

VMware Private AI Services — a GenAI platform layer on VCF providing a Model Gallery/governance, ML API gateway (Models-as-a-Service), data indexing/retrieval with pgvector vector DB, and an Agent Builder UI for composing enterprise AI agents from models and knowledge bases. [VMware by Broadcom; NVIDIA]

Broadcom internal AI coding assistant — developers get AI-powered code suggestions integrated in their editors, served via Codeium and Tabnine models deployed on GPU-backed Kubernetes clusters on VMware Private AI Foundation. Stated as implemented internally at Broadcom today. [Codeium; Tabnine (on VMware Private AI Foundation)]

Custom AI accelerator (XPU/ASIC) co-design for Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) — Broadcom is Google's primary partner designing the TPUs that power Google Search, Google Cloud AI, and Google's own models in production. Analysts estimate Broadcom holds ~80% of Google TPU design share. [Google (TPU); Broadcom custom silicon]
